// Safety against division by zero\n\n  const double ratio = fast_glue / slow_glue;\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart GMTR: fast=%g slow=%g last=%u T=%g ratio=%g trigger=%d\",\n                            fast_glue, slow_glue, last_lbd, T, ratio, (int) (ratio \u003e T));\n\n  return (ratio \u003e T);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]},"index":0}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
